purpose: Geospatial vector data — watershed polygons, gauge locations, masking, area calculations

GeoDataFrame.to_crs.note: Always reproject before area/length calculations. EPSG:4326 areas are meaningless (degrees, not metres).

GeoDataFrame.clip.note: Both geometries must be in the same CRS. Reproject the mask or the GeoDataFrame before clipping.

gotchas: EPSG:4326 is degrees — never compute .area or .length in this CRS. Reproject to an equal-area CRS first (EPSG:5070 for CONUS, EPSG:3857 is NOT equal-area).
gdf.geometry.iloc[0] vs gdf.geometry — single-row GeoDataFrames need .iloc[0] to get the shapely geometry object.
read_file() raises DriverError if fiona is missing. Install with: pip install geopandas[all] or pip install fiona.
Mixing CRS silently: GeoDataFrame.overlay() and .sjoin() do NOT auto-reproject — both must be in the same CRS.
Empty geometry: check gdf.is_empty.any() before operations. NLDI sometimes returns empty polygons for ungauged sites.
CRS comparison: use gdf.crs == other.crs not str(gdf.crs) == str(other.crs) — string representations differ across versions.
Writing to GeoJSON always writes in EPSG:4326 — reproject before writing if you need a different CRS.
shapely 2.x changed geometry creation: use shapely.from_wkt() not shapely.wkt.loads().

common_patterns.mask_raster:
import rasterio.mask
with rasterio.open(raster_path) as src:
    geom = [gdf.to_crs(src.crs).geometry.iloc[0].__geo_interface__]
    out_image, out_transform = rasterio.mask.mask(src, geom, crop=True)
    out_meta = src.meta.copy()
common_patterns.point_from_coords:
import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import Point
gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame({'id': ['g1']}, geometry=[Point(lon, lat)], crs='EPSG:4326')
